WITH feb_sales AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2001 AND d.d_moy = 2
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(r.sr_return_amt)
   FROM store_returns r
   JOIN feb_sales f ON f.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number
                   AND f.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk) AS ret_amt,
  (SELECT SUM(f.ss_net_paid) FROM feb_sales f) AS net_paid,
  ROUND(
    (SELECT SUM(r.sr_return_amt)
     FROM store_returns r
     JOIN feb_sales f ON f.ss_ticket_number = r.sr_ticket_number
                     AND f.ss_item_sk = r.ss_item_sk)
    / (SELECT SUM(f.ss_net_paid) FROM feb_sales f) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct;
